Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ChunkingConfig, ExtractionConfig, ChunkerType, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/plain", uri="https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt")
    config = ExtractionConfig(chunking=ChunkingConfig(chunker_type=ChunkerType("text"), max_characters=300, overlap=40, trim=True))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].chunks)

asyncio.run(main())
```
